completeProcedures.metamagicAdept:
Keep personal spellcasting and total character level4. NEW grant a separate pool of two feat sorcery points, maximum2, initially full and restored to2only by a beneficial Long Rest. There is no RP/RC/HP/charge exchange, class-resource conversion, overcap or refill from ordinary spell refunds. At acquisition permanently choose two distinct modes from the finite three-mode menu below, based explicitly on the actual Mage Metaspell Access card; this does not acquire that Mage card or its Long-Rest use.

Reach: spend1point when committing a personal spell cast to add30feet to its finite positive numeric casting range. Self,Touch,unlimited and a separate effect/command radius do not gain range. Widen: spend1point at commitment to add5feet to one circular/spherical area radius or one cone length of that actual spell; choose the one eligible dimension in advance, not all independent areas/parameters. It does not create an area on a single-target spell. Sculpt: spend1point at commitment to choose up to max(1,actual casting ability modifier) eligible creatures in that spell’s initial area; they automatically succeed on its initial save and take no damage if that success would normally halve damage. Their later saves/ticks and nondamage successful-save consequences follow the original spell; there is no permanent friendly-fire immunity.

NEW one metamagic mode total per cast across this feat and Mage Metaspell Access; declare which actual source pays. You cannot use two points for two modes or duplicate a class mode on the same cast. Other separately applicable feats keep their exact scopes. Spell Sniper doubles the printed numeric range first, then Reach adds30; it does not double Reach’s30. The chosen mode adds no spell rank, RPdiscount, Action, concentration slot or second cast. Commit the point with the legal spell; a later miss, save, counter or interruption refunds neither. Illegal mode/target declarations spend nothing. The spell still needs all its own resources, components and access.
completeProcedures.elementalAdept: Choose one of acid,cold,fire,lightning or thunder permanently. Only your actual personally cast spell-damage components of that chosen type ignore resistance to that type. NEW this bypass covers normal half resistance and an explicit percentage reduction actually identified as resistance, but not immunity, vulnerability, damage thresholds, cover, generic flat prevention, target ineligibility or a protection not classed as resistance. No extra damage entitlement is created. For each genuine damage die of that type belonging to the spell’s own roll, treat a final rolled face1as2after authorized rerolls. Critical dice qualify as actual spell damage dice; each die identity is adjusted once. A maximum substituted without a roll has no rolled1to change. Flat1damage is not a damage die. Mixed components of other types are unchanged. Independent weapon/item riders and summoned-creature attacks do not become spell damage from this feat. No automatic conversion of the spell’s damage type or effect on spells cast by allies.
completeProcedures.elemental_mastery:
Require an actual acquired route to cast at least one rank3spell; total level or sufficientRP alone does not qualify. Choose acid,cold,fire,lightning or thunder permanently. NEW at legal cast commitment, choose whether to convert all of that spell’s own damage, or all components of one or more declared original damage types, to your chosen type for that entire cast. Record the mapping before attacks/saves; no reactive switching after learning a defense or rolling damage. Its later genuine spell-native pulses use the same mapping, while independent riders, summoned-creature/weapon attacks and other creatures’ effects retain their own types unless the original spell itself expressly calls those packets its own spell damage.

Conversion changes damage type only. Dice,amount,school,rank,range,actions,target exclusions,components,concentration and conditions keep their exact rules. A condition named Burning, Chilled or Shocked is not renamed or removed merely because a damage component changes; actual immunity to that condition still applies. Healing/tempHP/resource costs cannot become damage. Changing necrotic damage tofire does not grant a new healing rider, and a spell’s existing “heal equal to actual damage” clause still uses its own lawful recorded amount. No freecast, generic upcast, environmental transformation or resistance bypass follows; Elemental Adept is a separate qualifying modifier.
completeProcedures.martial_adept_advanced: Require exact martialAdept. Choose two additional distinct entries from that same six-maneuver menu, excluding the two already known; permanent choices. Increase the common feat superiority pool capacity by one die of the same sized6, for two total; NEW the newly granted die begins available on actual acquisition, not each rest or retarget. CompletedSR/LR restores the shared pool to its current capacity once. Known maneuver count becomes four, not four copies of one option. No larger die, additional class resource, extraAction, simultaneous multiple-die payment or free retraining. Same underlying event may still use at most one superiority maneuver unless a future expressly priced source overrides it.
completeProcedures.martialAdept: The literal Battle Master archetype/superiority-die source has no matching current class-card menu. NEW use the six feat-only maneuver definitions below, each fully specified from existing ordinary actions with a finite die spend. At acquisition permanently choose two different maneuverIDs; gain a separate pool of one superiorityd6, initially available and recovered on completedSR orLR. One die can fund only one declared maneuver on one event; noRP/RC/class-resource exchange or conversion. All maneuvers pay their own actual Action/BA/Reaction or attack-replacement timing, with ordinary target/body legality. A committed attempt spends its die even on miss/failure/countering; illegal attempts spend nothing. The rolled result is used only as the selected maneuver states, not free damage on every maneuver. It grants no Soldier Coordinated Maneuver, class levels or Battle Master subclass. Choices cannot be changed for free at rest.

completeManeuverMenu.name: Measured Strike
completeManeuverMenu.activation: Within one actual weapon attack, before its attack roll
completeManeuverMenu.procedure: Roll the spentd6 and add it to that one attack roll. Choose before seeing the d20/outcome; natural1 still misses and no extra critical range is created. It adds no damage and supplies no attack, target permission or extra Action.

completeManeuverMenu.name: Driving Shove
completeManeuverMenu.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary Shove
completeManeuverMenu.cost: One superiorityd6 plus the replaced attack
completeManeuverMenu.procedure: Before both opposed rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to yourSTR Athletics total for that one ordinary Shove. Target choosesAthletics/Acrobatics; tie preserves state. Actual reach/one-size-larger cap applies; success still pushes5ft away OR Prone, never both solely from this maneuver. It adds no damage.

completeManeuverMenu.name: Disarming Feint
completeManeuverMenu.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary opposed Disarm
completeManeuverMenu.procedure: Choose a reachable actually held droppable item and an ordinary legal Athletics or weapon-check Disarm. Before rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to your one opposed total; defender usesAthletics/Acrobatics, tie preserves state. Success uses the existing adjacent/own-space drop placement, not automatic custody. No damage, severed bond or proficiency grant. The save-based Disarm feat and Whip Control are separate procedures and do not acquire this bonus.

completeManeuverMenu.name: Guarding Deflection
completeManeuverMenu.activation: Reaction when one direct damage event would damage you
completeManeuverMenu.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Reaction
completeManeuverMenu.procedure: After passive defenses but before tempHP, spend/roll1d6 to reduce that whole resolved event by its face, minimum0. Allocate across stable native component order. Attached conditions remain. No re-mitigation of transfer packets that forbid recipient mitigation, HP sacrifice, state assignment or direct death. It neither changes a hit to a miss nor qualifies as Riposte's successful Parry.

completeManeuverMenu.name: Measured Advance
completeManeuverMenu.activation: Bonus Action on your own regular turn
completeManeuverMenu.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual BA
completeManeuverMenu.procedure: Spend/roll1d6, gaining a separate movement-cost budget of5×face feet resolved immediately. Use one already available movement mode with nonzeroSpeed, pay normal terrain/crawl/squeeze costs, respect legal endpoints and provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. No teleport, new movement mode, free Disengage, replenished ordinary movement or banked distance. Interrupted unspent distance is lost.

completeManeuverMenu.name: Rallying Signal
completeManeuverMenu.activation: Action under the ordinary Rally procedure
completeManeuverMenu.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Action
completeManeuverMenu.procedure: Choose one actual ally within30ft able to perceive the rally and one active source-qualifiedFrightened record. Before rolling the ordinaryCHA task check at its sourceDC (otherwise10), spend/roll thed6 and add its face to the total. Apply actual task degrees/natural shift; success ends only that selected record. NoHP/tempHP, loyalty, extra save, new ally turn or automatic cure of other fear records.

limits: This is finite permanent selection/payment/initialization evidence, not complete five-feat use or all335 acquisitions.

The Warrior/paid-Initiate histories use actual class schedules and training projections. Wizard witnesses are explicit ability/class-level/repertoire subsets; a complete book/class-card acquisition history is not claimed.
Prepared reviewed Dispel Magic establishes the Wizard rank3 access witness. Sufficient RP, total level, an unprepared entry or rank1 Initiate access does not.

Previously spent superiority dice and sorcery points are explicit conditional prior-use premises. This pass does not execute maneuver actions, cast commitment, attack/task outcomes, beneficial-rest recovery or refund rules.

Elemental damage conversion/resistance/die-floor effects and stacking with actual spell packets remain use-procedure work. Metamagic range/area/save effects, Mage source arbitration and spell costs remain separate.
No class feature, animal, physical item, extra resource pool, spell access, source promotion, actual campaign event, human balance or software implementation is created.
